summary: Audited the frozen PR tree, reproduction runner/workflow, guarantee limits, and renderer contract against fresh clean CI evidence. Primary run/job 41123116952/124294552127 and all ten PR workflows succeeded; the extracted report matched: 63 scripts, 2,463 actions/native frames, 4,926 comparisons, zero mismatches, and all five controls had expected outcomes. The report distinguishes the finite Chromium profile from unsupported engines/features and states another renderer's admission, lifecycle, event, and replay requirements.
